name: Unverified 0x6077
fix_description: The uniswapV3SwapCallback (0xfa461e33) trusts msg.sender as a legitimate V3 pool without validation. Add verification that msg.sender is a pool deployed by the canonical Uniswap V3 factory (compute expected pool address from token0, token1, fee and verify msg.sender matches).
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a short but protocol-specific multi-step price/manipulation attack: flash-loan BUSD, swap into UN, abuse repeated pair.skim() calls after asymmetric token transfers, then swap back and repay. It requires understanding UniswapV2 pair reserve/balance mechanics and the non-obvious skim abuse pattern, so it is more involved than a basic access control bug but not a deeply complex cross-protocol chain.
